total_field_owner: axial Maxwell; no native Poisson self-E addition
current_port: distributed impressed upper-to-lower branch on positive-z foil end
current_measured: total port current with explicit conduction, plasma, displacement, boundary and charge accumulation
voltage: predicted minus same-stage E line integral along the unit feed branch
conditional_voltage_pulse: comparison only, never a second constraint
short: ideal PEC transverse sheet at negative-z foil end; heating in this sheet is not modeled
initialization: supported first C19 knot; declared uniform-temperature DC scenario, full scalar potential and closed-loop magnetostatics
gauge: scalar short potential zero; magnetostatic tangential A=0 at outer air box with Coulomb penalty
outer_boundary: finite impedance plus explicit static matched initial-state boundary source; finite box not exterior-qualified
material: conditional nominal SS304 evaluated solid 300..1500 K; rho_ref=8000 kg/m3 scenario, fixed-reference-volume Cp-as-Cv approximation
thermal: one sealed native thermal coupler per electrode per axial slice; no axial diffusion in this bounded pilot
